label: API Reference

List the project's milestones.

Propose a milestone plan. Creating one replaces any plan the project already has. Normally opens the interactive editor and answers { status: 'waiting_for_user_interaction', requestId, milestones } while the user reviews it. When human review is off for the project, or effective tool settings bypass the milestone editor, the proposal is applied as-is and the answer is { status: 'auto-applied', message, milestones } — no requestId, because nothing is waiting on you. Only the milestone tool's own SDK token may call this route; a token minted for any other tool is refused with 403. Reading milestones stays open to every authenticated tool.
Move the project to a different milestone. Only the milestone tool's own SDK token may call this route; a token minted for any other tool is refused with 403.

endpoints.summary: List the available workflows. Reading stays open to every authenticated tool.
Create a new workflow. Only the workflow tool's own SDK token may call this route; a token minted for any other tool is refused with 403.
Assign a workflow to one or more agents. Only the workflow tool's own SDK token may call this route; a token minted for any other tool is refused with 403.
Create a user-defined tool. Default scope is global (every project); scope:'project' confines it to the calling token's project. Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.

Register an already-running external MCP server by URL and auto-discover its tools (approval-gated: the backend connects out to the given URL). Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
Register a local or remote MCP server and auto-discover its tools. Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
Delete a user-defined tool. scope:'project' removes the copy scoped to the calling token's project; default removes the global tool. Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
Move a user-defined tool between global and project scope (promote or demote). Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
Rescan user-defined tools and notify clients so a newly-created tool surfaces without a restart. Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
List all registered tools.
Browse the tool catalog — id, name, description, method ids, origin per tool.
endpoints.response: { tools: { id, name, description, methods: string[], origin }[] }

endpoints.summary: Copy a tool's whole package into the calling project's folder so an agent can read it with the filesystem tool. Requires a project-scoped token held by the tool-management tool.
endpoints.response: { id, name, origin, path, files: string[], methods: unknown[] }
